verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB takes plain MergeTree DDL and claims every ClickHouse query works unchanged. That implies standard SQL deletion and table-level retention, but nothing documents retention or deletion explicitly. Agent data branches can be thrown away after use, and automated daily backups and point-in-time recovery are documented, but backup retention is not described as user-controllable. Missing for 10: explicit retention/TTL controls, documented data deletion guarantees (including backups, branches and query logs), user-configurable backup/log retention windows, account-level data deletion, independent corroboration.
